children: Michael F. Devine III, a director, reported direct sales of Five Below common stock on September 4, 2026, consisting of two transactions totaling 4,250 shares at reported prices of $250.44 and a weighted average of $251.28, for total reported proceeds of $1,065,084; he beneficially owned 12,953 shares following the transactions.

Kenneth R. Bull, chief operating officer, reported direct sales of Five Below common stock on September 4, 2026, consisting of 14 sales totaling 10,510 shares executed at varying prices with weighted average per-share prices reported for each block, for total reported proceeds of $2,607,113; he directly owned 75,064 shares following the transactions.
